title: Eighth Word The Fortunate Brothers Journey And The Talismans Opening

questions.question: What kind of person is the second brother at the start of this passage?
questions.answer: He is wise, fortunate, and good in character.

questions.question: Why did he not suffer as much trouble as his brother?
questions.answer: He kept good manners, thought positively, and followed the right order.

questions.question: How did things around him seem because of his good way of thinking?
questions.answer: They seemed friendly and familiar to him.

questions.question: What place did he come to on his journey?
questions.answer: He came to a garden with both beautiful things and dirty, rotten things.

questions.question: How did his brother react to that kind of garden earlier?
questions.answer: He focused on the ugly parts, felt disgusted, and left without resting.

questions.question: What rule did this brother follow in the garden?
questions.answer: He chose to notice the good side instead of the bad side.

questions.question: What happened because he paid attention to the good things in the garden?
questions.answer: He benefited from them, rested well, and continued peacefully.

questions.question: What danger appeared in the desert?
questions.answer: A lion came at him.

questions.question: Was he afraid of the lion? Explain.
questions.answer: Yes, but much less than his brother because he believed there was wisdom and control behind it.

questions.question: What thought gave him comfort when he saw the lion?
questions.answer: He thought the desert must have a ruler and the lion might be under that ruler’s command.

questions.question: Where did he jump while running from the lion?
questions.answer: He jumped into a deep, empty well.

questions.question: What kept him from falling all the way down?
questions.answer: He grabbed a tree growing from the side of the well.

questions.question: What two things did he see attacking the tree?
questions.answer: He saw two animals chewing its two roots.

questions.question: What did he see above and below him?
questions.answer: He saw the lion above and the dragon below.

questions.question: How did his fear compare with his brother’s fear?
questions.answer: He was scared, but far less terrified than his brother.

questions.question: What made his fear smaller?
questions.answer: His good morals gave him good thoughts, and those thoughts helped him see a hopeful side.

questions.question: What did he understand about the strange events around him?
questions.answer: He understood they were connected and under the command of a hidden ruler.

questions.question: What did he realize about himself after that?
questions.answer: He realized he was not alone and that he was being watched, tested, and led somewhere for a purpose.

questions.question: What feeling grew in him after he wanted to know the hidden ruler?
questions.answer: Love for the one who owned the mystery grew in him.

questions.question: What came after that love?
questions.answer: He wanted to understand the mystery and gain good qualities that would please the ruler.

questions.question: What was strange about the fig tree he saw?
questions.answer: One tree seemed to carry the fruits of many thousands of trees.

questions.question: Why did this discovery remove his fear?
questions.answer: He understood it was a sign, not an ordinary tree, and that it showed the power and planning of the hidden ruler.

questions.question: What did he think the ruler had done with the fruits?
questions.answer: He thought the ruler had placed examples of many fruits there for guests.

questions.question: What did he ask for before making his prayer?
questions.answer: He asked to be shown the key to the mystery.

questions.question: In his prayer, what did he say about his relationship to the ruler?
questions.answer: He said he took refuge in the ruler, was the ruler’s servant, and wanted to please him.

questions.question: What happened right after his supplication?
questions.answer: The wall opened, a door appeared, and the place changed into a lovely, peaceful garden.

questions.question: How did the dragon and lion change?
questions.answer: They became like servants, and the lion even became a gentle riding animal.

questions.question: What lesson is introduced at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The passage invites us to compare the two brothers and see that good leads to good while evil leads to evil.

questions.question: How is the second traveler described in this passage?
questions.answer: He is shown as lucky, smart, and well-behaved.

questions.question: What helped him move along without the misery his brother felt?

questions.question: How did he view the world around him?

questions.question: Why was the first brother unable to rest in a similar garden?

questions.question: What choice did the second brother make in the garden?

questions.question: What does this show about his way of thinking?
questions.answer: It shows he tried to see the better side of things.

questions.question: After leaving the garden, where did he go?
questions.answer: He entered a large desert.

questions.question: What idea made him calmer than his brother?

questions.question: What did he do when he was still afraid?
questions.answer: He ran and then threw himself into a deep well.

questions.question: What held him in the middle of the well?
questions.answer: A tree growing from the side of the well held him.

questions.question: What danger was above him?

questions.question: What danger was below him?

questions.question: What other threat did he notice near the tree?

questions.question: Why did he not panic as much as his brother?

questions.question: What did he think the strange events proved?
questions.answer: He thought they showed that someone powerful was directing them.

questions.question: What did he begin to believe that hidden ruler was doing?
questions.answer: He believed the ruler was watching him, testing him, and leading him for a reason.

questions.question: What question rose in his heart because of this?
questions.answer: He wanted to know who the ruler was and why he was being guided that way.

questions.question: What grew from his wish to know the ruler?
questions.answer: Love for the ruler grew in his heart.

questions.question: What grew from that love?
questions.answer: He wanted to solve the mystery and become pleasing to the ruler.

questions.question: What did he do after realizing this?
